The 3 things they don't want you to know about AI.

Swipe. Takes 30 seconds. 🧵👇

1. The free version is enough to start.

You don't need a paid plan or a course to get real work done today.

2. It's only as good as what you tell it.

"Write an email" gets you something generic.

"I own a bakery. A customer's order was late. Write a short apology and offer 10% off."

gets you something you'd actually send.

3. Make it ask you questions first.

Add this to any request:

"Before you answer, ask me 3 questions."

The answer gets noticeably better.

It can be wrong.

It sounds confident either way. Read everything before you send it.

Want it to know your business?

The prompts small business owners actually use.

Copy, paste, fill in the brackets. Works in Claude or ChatGPT. 🧵👇

1. Reply to a customer

"Reply to this customer. Short and friendly. Answer the question and offer a time to book: [message]"

2. Follow up on a quote

"Write a 2 sentence follow up on a quote I sent 3 days ago. No pressure."

3. Ask for a review

"Write a short text asking a happy customer for a Google review. Keep it casual."

4. Handle a price objection

"A customer says I'm too expensive. Help me explain my price clearly and politely."

5. Plan the day

"Here's my to do list. Order it by what brings in money first: [list]"

6. Answer a bad review

"Write a calm, professional reply to this review: [review]"

7. Write captions

"Give me 5 short captions about [what I did today]. Plain language, no hashtags."

8. Set it up once

"Ask me 5 questions about my business, then write instructions so you always answer the way I would."

That's a Business Brain.

How to use Claude if you've never used AI.

10 slides. No tech terms. 🧵👇

1. Go to claude.ai or download the app.

Sign up free with your email.

2. Write like you're texting a capable assistant.

No special wording needed. Say what you need.

3. Tell it who you are.

"I run a cleaning business in Miami."

One line of context changes every answer.

4. Paste things in.

Emails, reviews, your menu, a photo of a receipt. It can read them.

5. Ask for changes.

"Shorter." "Friendlier." "More like how I talk." It rewrites in seconds.

6. Have it ask questions first.

"Ask me 3 questions before you answer."

7. Save your details once.

Put them in a Project so every chat already knows them.

8. Check before you send.

It's fast, not perfect. Read every word.
